description.value: Shine Cafe has been serving Victoria's best brunch since 2004, earning a reputation for gourmet takes on breakfast classics like Eggs Benedict and famous pancakes made from scratch with locally sourced ingredients. The cafe has been featured on the Canada Food Network three times and reviewed widely in local publications, making it a well-established stop on Fort Street. Both dine-in and take-out are available, with outdoor seating and a broad menu that accommodates vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free diets.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces, covered) at 19m; rack (4 spaces, covered) at 45m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact fields (address, phone, website). The site explicitly confirms take-out service and lists vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free dietary options including a dedicated vegan brunch item. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags beyond outdoor_seating=yes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe in Victoria with a confirmed website and consistent contact details. A well-known brunch destination useful to touring cyclists seeking a meal stop.

Takeout.detail: Website states: 'Shine is open from 8am to 2pm daily for dine-in and take-out.'

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About Us page states: 'lots of options to accommodate dietary restrictions, including vegan, gluten-free, nut-free and more.' Menu includes a dedicated 'Karin's Vegan Brunch' and a gluten-free bagel option
